mappingNotes: Mapping B adds CIS section 18 Administrative Templates using the exact remediation UI path documented by CIS.
The mapping is locale-sensitive: CIS uses English policy/category names, while GPMC/ADML output may be localized. No translation or fuzzy matching is performed.
A mapped key is therefore a precise reference key, not a claim that a localized customer snapshot can always be matched automatically.

notes: Mapping A only: Account Policies, User Rights Assignment and Security Options.
Administrative Templates, audit policy, services, firewall and other benchmark sections are intentionally not mapped in this step.
Target expressions preserve CIS wording; no compliance normalization or score is calculated.
Security Options use the benchmark display name as mapping key; localization differences in customer snapshots remain an explicit follow-up item.
Mapping B: Administrative Templates are derived only from the documented CIS remediation UI path. No name similarity, translation or registry-only inference is used.
Mapping D: Advanced Audit Policy is reference-only. No settingKey is generated because the current snapshot parser does not expose a verified bridge for auditpol/Advanced Audit Policy.
Mapping E: Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security is reference-only. No settingKey is generated without a verified snapshot bridge.
Mapping F: System Services is reference-only. No settingKey is generated without a verified service-state data bridge.
